name: (BERSERK) Confrontation with the Void Apostle
description: You stand in a dark, distorted dimension where the air trembles with psychic energy. Before you appears the Void Apostle — a creature with an exposed brain whose power manipulates reality. Its gaze penetrates the soul, and its aura suppresses the will. Prepare for battle with this demonic leader, relying on endurance and cunning in this nightmarish world.
